{{Quote|I'm a prisoner here... I've been tortured by these despicable Trandoshans for weeks now. Please help me.|Arrworr, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:Gc" />}}
'''Arrworr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Arrworr was captured by a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]] led by the slavemaster [[Trussk]]. The Wookiee was shipped to a [[Trussk's house|building]] owned by the Trandoshans in the city of [[Keren/Legends|Keren]], on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. There, he was tortured for weeks.<ref name="SWG:Gc" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the building was attacked by a group of spacers. These adventurers were investigating the disappearance of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] known as [[Cal Handro]] who was wanted dead by the Blackscale Clan. The spacer killed most slavers, including the slavemaster Trussk, and eventually freed the Wookiee. After escaping the house, Arrworr revealed to the spacers that the missing pilot was tracked by the slavemaster for having [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggled]] slaves for a rival Trandoshan clan but had never been seen there.<ref name="SWG:Gc" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arrworr was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]].<ref name="SWG:Gc" /> The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Arrworr was added to the game with the third chapter of the "[[W:c:swg:Secrets of the Syren|Secrets of the Syren]]" quest line, released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 19 Notes for 29 June 2005|Publish 19]]," on [[June 29]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=757|text=Update Notes: Publish 19.0 - June 29th, 2005}}</ref> The "Secrets of the Syren" story arc was removed from the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]], due to the major changes planed for Rori with the introduction of the [[Battle of Restuss]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
